description: This file defines the RedisClusteringProviderBuilder class, which implements configuration logic for Redis clustering in Orleans, including methods to configure silo and client builders with connection options.

classes.name: RedisClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring Redis clustering providers for Orleans silos and clients.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Redis clustering with options based on the provided configuration section.

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the client builder to use Redis clustering with options based on the provided configuration section.
